title: Crosby's bus meeting Krupa's band on the road
summary: Two touring bands meet on the road, with Charlie Teagarden jumping out to greet friends.

blocks.x: Another thing we talked about was, uh, the different bands you would meet up with when you were out on the road. Yeah. And you'd run across them. Like your, uh, the two band buses would meet. Oh, yeah.

Well, uh, we were at the Crosby band and we were going, I don't know, north or south. And, and they were coming in on their bus going north or south, something like that. And we'd meet on the road, we'd pull on the side. And that's what, that's what I showed you that picture of Gene Krupa came over. Mm-hmm. Well, uh, well, I was with, uh, Jimmy Dawson's band at the time, see. So, Charlie Teagarden and I jumped out the car and say hello to the guys, you know. Yeah. Because we knew some of the guys that were in each band, you know.
